title: Number of Distinct Islands
description: Count the number of distinct islands in a binary matrix. Islands are considered the same if one can be translated to match the other.
pseudocode:
1. Set shapes = new Set()
2. For r in rows, c in cols:
3.   If grid[r][c] == 1:
4.     path = []
5.     dfs(r, c, 'o', path)
6.     shapes.add(path.join(','))
7. return shapes.size

8. dfs(r, c, dir, path):
9.   if out of bounds or grid[r][c] == 0: return
10.  grid[r][c] = 0
11.  path.push(dir)
12.  dfs(r+1, c, 'D', path)
13.  dfs(r-1, c, 'U', path)
14.  dfs(r, c+1, 'R', path)
15.  dfs(r, c-1, 'L', path)
16.  path.push('B')
